about.description: Copper perpetual market. The contract tracks copper pricing and gives users linear exposure to a core industrial metal used across manufacturing, electrification, and infrastructure. Users do not own metal inventory or warehouse receipts. Pricing uses an external copper reference. Positions are margined and cash-settled in USDC. Markets are visible on Hyperliquid under the xyz namespace, but are operated by trade[XYZ] rather than listed as core Hyperliquid perps.
